_readme: Editorial metadata + declared chapter structure for the career-guidance library.
Chapter structure is DECLARED here rather than detected, because the ten source
documents were hand-authored over years and their Word outline levels are not
semantically usable (New DOCX Document.docx puts real chapters and 'Quick Facts'
both at heading 1; career guidance after class 10.docx marks chapters with
heading 2 and SUBsections with heading 1; commerce.docx numbers chapters 4-9 but
not 1-3). Run the command with --propose to regenerate a first-draft chapter list
for a document, then check the corrected list in here.
chapter_titles entries are either a verbatim heading string, or
{match, title} when the source has no chapter-level heading at all and the
chapter has to be opened on its first subsection.
'stage' drives the Library filter chips; 'stage_order' their display order.
'legacy_slugs' keeps already-published URLs alive after a slug change.

abroad3.docx.title: Study Abroad — Complete Guide
abroad3.docx.blurb: 17 phases from understanding study abroad to scholarships, visas and country guides
abroad3.docx._note: The board's GUIDE section ('16 phases and 697 topics') is THIS document, not abroad2.0.docx — its phase titles and topic counts match the board's cards exactly (1=12, 2=25, 4=25, 5=38, 6=42, 7=49, 8=44; only 3 differs, 31 vs 30). abroad2.0 was imported first on data quality and was the WRONG source. PHASE 1 has NO heading (the document opens straight at '1.1 What is Study Abroad?'), so it is opened on that subsection and keep_as_section stays true — the other 16 are real headings being renamed, so they set it false. There is no PHASE 14 in the source. 🔴 PHASE 13 (COUNTRY-WISE EDUCATION GUIDE) MUST be declared even though its content is also the Countries tab: omitting it does NOT drop it, it merges ~1,995 country sections into chapter 12, which then reports 2,013 sections instead of 18. That is why this is 17 phases where the board prints 16.
